messages:
mia_sales: Quick sync  prospect (payments startup) asked for a VPC/on-prem POC quote: 6-week POC, 1 inference GPU, KV cache, KMS, enterprise support. They asked if platform license can be waived for POC.
raj_sol: Confirming GPU is inference-only? If so we use Dedicated inference SKU. KMS needs an integration SOW and one-time fee.
mia_sales: Correct  inference-only. They want temporary waiver and a strong conversion incentive.
anna_fin: We only waive platform fee for POC if theres credible conversion (12mo reserved or ARR floor). Can do convertible credit instead of retro-billing.
mia_sales: Proposal: waive platform fee during POC; if they sign a 12mo reserved commit within 30 days, the waived amount becomes a credit against first invoices; otherwise credit expires. Also offer 20% conversion discount for first 6 months.
kevin_legal: Legal prefers convertible credit language in SOW. Draft clause: "POC Platform Fees will be credited to Customer's invoice(s) upon execution of a Reserved Capacity Agreement within 30 days; otherwise credits expire."
deal-desk-bot: Note: any waiver or credit >15% triggers Deal Desk review. Attach rate card and SOW.
anna_fin: Finance will accept convertible credit if we have a floor: >= $150k ARR or 12mo reserved. Also cap credit to 6 months of platform fees.
mia_sales: Customers projected ARR if converted = ~$200k. I'll include forecast.
raj_sol: Technical OK. We'll include KMS integration appendix.
kevin_legal: Send final SOW to Legal for redline.
deal-desk-bot: Created action DD-2026-118. Please attach final docs for approval.
mia_sales: Thanks all  updating SOW and will upload for Deal Desk shortly.
